summary: Frontend-only theme regression testing completed on public URL for Hamilton team switcher update. Core requirements passed: Ferrari clean default, 3 top-nav logo/name buttons with aria-pressed, global accent switching (Ferrari/Mercedes/McLaren), localStorage persistence, state preservation while switching, responsive fit at 1920x800 and 390x844, and no console/runtime page errors.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for this requested frontend scope.
Optional: if route hash consistency is desired, align hash with overview when using Back to Circuit (current tested behavior keeps prior chapter hash while active view returns to circuit).
critical_code_review_comments: Theme system is correctly centralized via CSS variables and data-team-theme modes; key yellow-driven accents now resolve through --acid/--accent-rgb.
Accessibility requirement implemented for switcher state via aria-pressed on all three team buttons.
Top-nav mobile layout remains within viewport bounds without horizontal overflow at 390x844.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://ui-revamp-dynamics.preview.emergentagent.com using Playwright automation with console capture and screenshots. Verified Ferrari default on clean visit by clearing localStorage key hamilton-team-theme and reloading. Confirmed top-nav McLaren/Mercedes/Ferrari buttons exist with logo+name, active visual state, aria-pressed toggling, and persisted selection through reload. Verified accent replacement on hero CTA/track, circuit racing line, HUD, and progress bar for cyan (#00d2be), papaya (#ff8700), and Ferrari red (#e10600). Confirmed team switching preserves current route/scroll/active chapter context and does not reset to top. Marker navigation, Back to Circuit, and Hero CTA remained functional in tested path. No .error/class*='error'/id*='error' messages detected and no blank viewport reproduced.
rca of the issue: No defects reproduced for the requested theme feature set. Implementation behavior matched acceptance criteria in both desktop and mobile checks.
